beats.summary: Michael and Kevin are alone in the office, discussing holding down the fort.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well, Kevin, I guess it is just me and you.

beats.summary: Angela is upset about Kevin not getting an answer and insists he come back.
Kevin expresses disappointment about not getting a cookie, leading to some playful banter.

evidence.snippet: Kevin (to Michael): Is there a cookie?

beats.summary: Michael compares the feeling of managing the office to the founders of Phillip-Morris feeling about their work.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Now I know what the founders of Phillip-Morris felt like.

beats.summary: Phyllis injures her back during a dance at Cafe Disco and needs help.
Michael insists on getting Phyllis medical attention quickly and dismisses the hospital as an option.
